### ① Derived judgments

Each judgment the diff implies, named right or wrong against the maintainer's ruling as quoted on the card (scope B, 「放宽(按我写的原文)」) and the texts the hunks cite.

1. **`SKILL.md` L171–172 — the relaxation as two exceptions.** RIGHT. L171 keeps the rule 「`domain:*` 只由分诊席产出」 and its tail 「无标签的卡 ⛔ 不得认领」, renumbering the sub-issue path 例外一. L172 (例外二) carries exactly the ruling's two conditions — 车道合上表 (the domain table L159–168 directly above) and 正文齐立卡门三件 — and its consequence 执行席直接认领,分诊事后抽查. Nothing beyond the ruling is added (no third condition, no new gate, label or script), which is what scope B requires. 「立卡门三件」 resolves to one source, `filing-gate.md` L26 (类别 ①–④、动手的读者、查重查询与命中数), not restated. Red lines L29 (never dispatch a `pm:retriage` card) and L36 (执行席只在本车道认领,永不改 `domain:*`) still hold against the new text: the seat accepts in its own lane and never rewrites the lane label.
2. **`execution-duties.md` L11 — candidate rule and the fail outcome.** RIGHT. 「车道合域表且正文齐 `filing-gate.md` 三件 ⇒ 候选;缺一 ⇒ 挂 `pm:retriage`」. The card left the fail outcome to the skills seat (leave for triage, or add `pm:retriage`); the pick sits inside the card and is the better one on the card's own facts: a card carrying `domain:*` + `pm:queue` + `priority:*` matches none of the sweep's disjuncts ①–④ (`triage-duties.md` L13–15), so 「leave it」 means nobody sees it. `pm:retriage` lands on existing machinery: L10 already excludes 无 `pm:retriage` from candidates; `SKILL.md` L103 and L111 skip such cards at dispatch; `state-machine.md` L39 makes the add legal only with the objection comment in the same stroke (证据 + 所求), and L40 has triage answer and strip it each fire. The new line inherits those, as one source should.
3. **`execution-duties.md` L42 — 「唯一绕过分诊」 → 「绕过分诊」.** RIGHT. With 例外二 the sub-issue path is no longer the only route past triage's first touch; keeping 「唯一」 would have made L42 false.
4. **`triage-duties.md` L17 — the spot-check and its discriminator.** RIGHT, with one acknowledged narrowness. 「窗内新派发且 `domain:*` 事件与建卡同分钟者,逐张核车道、三件;⛔ 不凭 actor」. (a) It finds what disjuncts ①–④ cannot, which the triage first grade (comment 6204072113) made binding. (b) 「窗内」 is the hourly `since` window L8 of the same file defines (anchor = the seat post's last brief), so 「since the last spot-check」 is the window, as the card's criterion asks. (c) Time is the right axis and actor the wrong one on AGENTS.md's own rule, independent of any timeline reading: every GitHub write leaves through `scripts/pm/` as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, filer and triage alike, so a label event's actor cannot separate them; the card's suggested actor-based test is unimplementable as stated and the text is right to say so. (d) The card's acceptance example — a card whose lane, state and grade labels were all written in the creation minute, later dispatched — is listed by this step on the card's own description of it. (e) Narrowness: 「同分钟」 reads as the same clock minute, so a filer whose label write crosses a minute boundary is missed; that makes the step a sample, which is what 「事后抽查」 names, and the line stands at the 120-byte cap. Not wrong; named so the seat reads the step as a sample, not a census.
5. **The three payments — lossless, each rule surviving at one source.** RIGHT, read at the head: (a) `SKILL.md` deleted L126 (the two accepted `Unlock-action:` spellings) survives at `state-machine.md` L28–29 — both forms and 「只认此二值,别的拼写静默回落重派」 — and `SKILL.md` L124 already sends the reader to that file for every hold/blocked line contract; `check-half-states.mjs` carries its own `Unlock-action:` reader and never reads `SKILL.md` for it. (b) `execution-duties.md` deleted L139 (dev 装不下预算 ⇒ 停手回报) survives at `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L292, the dev's definition; the PM half (head L139: the dispatch word carries the budget) and the review rule (head L183: 超派发预算 ⇒ REWORK) both stay; `dispatch-runbook.md` L188 names SKILL.md and the dev definition as the single source of dev duties, so the PM-side restatement was the duplicate. (c) `triage-duties.md` deleted L88 (维持或改判皆由分诊席同笔摘标;挂标归异议席) survives at head L88 (答后同笔摘标 — both outcomes, since answering is the act) and `state-machine.md` L39–40 (挂标者 = 异议席, 摘标者 = 分诊 Routine). No re-wrap used as payment: every edit is a whole-line add, a whole-line delete or a same-line rewrite.
6. **Ratchet and byte caps — no raise, no move.** RIGHT, measured on the head tree: 319/319, 188/188, 120/120 lines; `CEILINGS` rows unchanged and `scripts/` untouched by the diff; the five added or rewritten lines are 119, 120, 118, 106 and 120 bytes; widest prose lines unchanged (SKILL.md's 342-byte widest is a table row under its own `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin, and no table row is edited); the four-axis block L241–261 is byte-identical to the base (md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`); no `#` followed by three or more digits enters any of the three files. The card's reading that the ruling lives in the body (filing gate ③) and so raises no cap is right, and the diff respects it.

The ruling names two conditions and scope B is 「按我写的原文」, so a third condition would exceed the ruling; whether the spot-check should also backfill the first-touch labels is a question for the seat or the maintainer, carried under ③.
